history.period: Late 20th century; consecrated 1995 CE per inheritage.foundation (verify - one passage on the same source page instead says 'completed 2012', an unresolved conflict)
history.summary: CHECKED AGAINST ACTUAL ISKCON CENTRE: inheritage.foundation's heritage survey is the only published source documenting an ISKCON temple in Dimapur, located at Signal Bosti, Dimapur (PIN 797112), Dimapur district, dedicated to Lord Krishna in the Orissan Nagara/Nagara style with neo-classical elements, maintained by the ISKCON Foundation. The temple was consecrated in 1995 CE according to the same source's heritage overview, though its conservation-status passage states the structure was 'completed 2012' - the two dates are in direct conflict and need verification. Cross-checking against ISKCON's own centre directory (centres.iskcon.org) did not return a Dimapur listing; the nearest listed ISKCON centre was the Imphal, Manipur temple (Airport Road, Ghari, ~126 km away), so this entry rests on a single secondary source and should be treated as provisional (verify location, consecration date and identity locally). No CSV town/district/state correction is needed: Signal Bosti is within Dimapur, Dimapur district, Nagaland. Typical ISKCON daily programme (Mangala Arati 4:30 AM through Shayana Arati 8:15 PM, darshan 4:30 AM-1:00 PM and 4:00-8:30 PM, free entry) is reported by the same source (verify hours before visiting).

name: ISKCON Dimapur
town_description: Dimapur is Nagaland's largest city and commercial gateway, lying in the foothills at the state's southwestern edge on the border with Assam. The only Nagaland city with a railway station and airport, it is the natural base for the state's small Hindu community (mostly Bengali, Nepali, Assamese, Marwari and Hindi-speaking settlers), whose temples cluster in areas like Signal Bosti, Marwari Patti and Railway Colony. Signal Bosti is a locality of Dimapur town (PIN 797112).

travel.airport: Dimapur Airport (DMU), the state's only airport, approx. 7-10 km from Signal Bosti (verify).
travel.railway: Dimapur railway station (Lumding-Dibrugarh section), approx. 4-6 km away (verify); auto-rickshaws and taxis available.
travel.road: Within Dimapur town; Signal Bosti is on the Dimapur local road network, reachable by auto-rickshaw/taxi from anywhere in town (verify).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March (pleasant dry season in Dimapur; major Vaishnava festivals - Janmashtami, Gaura Purnima, Radhashtami - draw the biggest celebrations).
visitor_information.opening_hours: Per inheritage.foundation: temple darshan 4:30 AM - 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM - 8:30 PM daily; aartis from Mangala Arati (4:30 AM) to Shayana Arati (8:15 PM); free entry (verify before visiting - single-source information). No reliable photograph of the actual Dimapur temple was found in image searches (results returned generic ISKCON images or ISKCON Bhubaneswar), so media is empty (verify locally).
